ambient_events: A tongue of old paint peels a little further from the wall.
description: Number 2C. Someone painted this one, once: a hopeful yellow now gone the colour of a smoker's teeth, peeling in long tongues off the plaster. A kitchenette with two working burners, a fold-down table, and a bathtub in the main room because the plumbing never reached the back. The window looks onto a brick wall an arm's length away.

window.description: One small window with a bad seal, letting in a draught and a slice of whatever the weather is doing.
window.name: the window
